title: Add command-scaled tracking variants to the candidate paper reward
summary: locomotion.paper_reward gains the audit's tracking variants: the paper's fixed 0.15 scale, a command-scaled kernel with scale 0.4 times the command, floored at the smallest bank command, and that kernel on each replica's causal 60-control mean velocity, restarted at command changes. A variant factory builds any configuration from a spec for the scorer and viewer, and the scorer now passes the replica count so stride averages stay per replica. Training still uses locomotion/task.py.
next: The reviewer chooses between the per-control and stride-averaged command-scaled kernels before reward v2 is implemented in locomotion/task.py.
reason: Candidate tracking variants scored offline change no measured result, roadmap marker, gate or the training reward in locomotion/task.py.
